how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-mulgore-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:743:obj:0: Bring 8 Windfury Talons to Ruul Eagletalon in Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:743:details:0: Thank you for taking the time to speak to me, ⟦1⟧. I am Ruul, warrior and teacher.
rows.quest:743:details:1: BYou have obviously reached an age when you must prepare for your trials if you are to adventure much further out of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:743:details:2: BIf you wish a test of your strength, start by seeking out the Windfury harpies to the southeast. They nestle along the mountain's edges away from the road.
rows.quest:743:details:3: BThey are one of our natural enemies here in ⟦E1⟧ and will be a good gauge of your skill.
rows.quest:743:completion:0: You have done well, ⟦2⟧. You seem well prepared to travel onward. Let the wind always be at your back.
rows.quest:745:obj:0: Kill 10 Palemane Tanners, 8 Palemane Skinners, and 5 Palemane Poachers, then return to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:745:details:0: ⟦3⟧, there are many conflicts that wound this land. It is my hope that you will not bear witness to as many of them as I have. Yet there is one that I would ask you to seek out. It will give you some sense of how terrible, if left unchecked, even a small threat can be to the land.
rows.quest:745:details:1: BPalemane gnolls have settled to the south of Bloodhoof and in a cave to the west. They disrespect our attempts to communicate with them, and they slay the wildlife of ⟦E1⟧ unbridled.
rows.quest:745:details:2: BWords are no longer the answer.
rows.quest:745:completion:0: ⟦4⟧, it is good you've taken my task seriously. Respect of the land and its creatures is important. Death and life are a circle... a necessity. One cannot exist without the other. Take time to ponder this and do well to never forget it.
rows.quest:746:obj:1: BAt a forge, smash the Prospector's Picks to create Broken Tools.
rows.quest:746:obj:2: BBring 5 Broken Tools to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:746:details:0: There are dwarves preparing a dig site to the northwest. They think secrets lie in the earth, and that is true, but hollowing and defiling the land is no way to earn its teachings.
rows.quest:746:details:1: BCollect the dwarven tools of digging, smash them, and return to me with the dwarves' broken tools.
rows.quest:746:details:2: BYou can smash the tools at a forge. You will find one in ⟦E2⟧, but any forge -- even a forge at the dwarven camp -- will suffice.
rows.quest:746:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦5⟧. This will calm the beasts of ⟦E1⟧. And, spirits willing, it will teach the dwarves that hollowing the land is not the path to knowledge.
rows.quest:748:obj:0: Bring 6 Prairie Wolf Paws and 4 Plainstrider Talons to Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof.
rows.quest:748:details:0: Goblins and their servants have tainted our sacred water wells! We cannot allow this.
rows.quest:748:details:1: BTo cleanse each well, I must create a cleansing totem, then you must bring the totem to the well and perform a cleansing ritual.
rows.quest:748:details:2: BFirst we will create a cleansing totem for the Winterhoof Water Well. To do this, the land must offer its aid. Hunt prairie wolves for their paws and adult plainstriders for their talons. They are to the southwest.
rows.quest:748:details:3: BReturn to me with the paws and talons, ⟦6⟧.
rows.quest:748:completion:0: You have done well, ⟦7⟧. I will take these and bind their power into a totem of cleansing.
rows.quest:749:obj:0: Morin Cloudstalker wants you to examine the contents of a supply crate at the Ravaged Caravan.
rows.quest:749:details:0: A few days ago, we found a Venture Co. caravan traveling under guard on the northern shore of Stonebull Lake. We'd lost two of our number in an earlier battle, so we were quick to attack and lay waste to the caravan.
rows.quest:749:details:1: BWe left their supply crates, thinking that our torches would destroy anything of value, but given that Venture Co. salvagers have been spotted near the burned wagons, maybe we were wrong.
rows.quest:749:details:2: BPerhaps you could go to the caravan and examine the contents of the crates.
rows.quest:749:completion:0: All sides of the crate are stamped with the sign of the Venture Co. ⟦E3⟧ Division. Notes printed carefully on the side of the carton indicate that the contents are due for processing at one of their central plants.
rows.quest:751:obj:0: Return the Venture Co. Documents to Morin Cloudstalker near Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:751:details:0: Prying open the lid reveals a tightly packed assortment of ore and minerals, more evidence of the Venture Co.'s mining operation in ⟦E1⟧. On the top of the ore and minerals you remove a tightly bound sheaf of papers.
rows.quest:751:details:1: BUp in the foothills to the east, you can barely hear the sounds of work, and see smoke rising from a large fire.
rows.quest:751:completion:0: It does indeed appear that the Venture Co. is attempting to rob us of our natural resources. It is good to know this for true, and now it seems, we must do something about it.
rows.quest:754:obj:0: Use the Winterhoof ⟦E4⟧ Totem at the Winterhoof Water Well, then return to Mull Thunderhorn.
rows.quest:754:details:0: I have crafted the totem to cleanse the Winterhoof Water Well. Now, you must take it to the well and perform a cleansing ritual. You will find it to the southeast, guarded by foul goblins!
rows.quest:754:details:1: BThis will not be an easy task, but you must do it if we are ever to use its waters again.
rows.quest:754:completion:0: News of your deed reached me moments ago -- already the beasts near the well drink from it eagerly.
rows.quest:754:completion:1: BYou have done a great thing for the land, ⟦9⟧. And you have done a great thing for the Tauren people.
rows.quest:756:obj:0: Bring 6 Stalker Claws and 6 Cougar Claws to Mull Thunderhorn.
rows.quest:756:details:0: To create the Thunderhorn ⟦E4⟧ Totem, you must gather the claws of the predators of the ⟦E1⟧ plains. Hunt prairie stalkers for their stalker claws and flatland cougars for their cougar claws, then return to me.
rows.quest:756:details:1: BYou will find the prairie stalkers and flatland cougars to the east and west.
rows.quest:756:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦10⟧. The purity with which these beasts hunt is vital in the creation of the next cleansing totem.
rows.quest:756:completion:1: BThe goblins will never learn the difference between contending with the land, and living in harmony with it.
rows.quest:758:obj:0: Use the Thunderhorn ⟦E4⟧ Totem at the Thunderhorn Water Well, then return to Mull.
rows.quest:758:details:0: The totem is ready, ⟦11⟧. And again, it is your task to perform the ritual of cleansing.
rows.quest:758:details:1: BGo to the Thunderhorn Water Well, north of the village, and use the Thunderhorn ⟦E4⟧ Totem in your ritual. After you do this, return to me.
rows.quest:758:completion:0: Ancestors of the Thunderhorn clan spoke to me in a dream, praising you for your actions near their well.
rows.quest:758:completion:1: BFor their gratitude, they wish to give you this...
rows.quest:759:obj:0: Bring 8 Prairie Alpha Teeth to Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:759:details:0: There is but one water well left to cleanse, named after the Wildmane clan. For this well to be pure, the land must offer the teeth of a fierce predator, the prairie wolf alpha. Find the alphas to the north, then return to me when your hunt is finished.
rows.quest:759:details:1: BAlphas often wander around the base of our mighty city, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:759:completion:0: Very good, ⟦12⟧. I can feel the sacrifice of the land in this offering, and my spirit swells with sadness, and pride.
rows.quest:760:obj:0: Use the Wildmane ⟦E4⟧ Totem at the Wildmane Water Well, then return to Mull Thunderhorn.
rows.quest:760:details:0: Your cleansing of the Winterhoof and Thunderhorn wells is spoken among the spirits, young ⟦13⟧. The Wildmane Totem is made, and your last task lies ahead.
rows.quest:760:details:1: BThe Wildmane Water Well lies north of ⟦E2⟧. Perform the ritual! ⟦E5⟧ the land of the goblins' poisons! Let clean water flow once again!
rows.quest:760:completion:0: You've done it. You have cleaned the wells, and healed our land. Bloodhoof village is grateful, ⟦14⟧.
rows.quest:760:completion:1: BMay the wind whisper your deeds for a hundred seasons, and may the waters of ⟦E1⟧ remain clean forever.
rows.quest:761:obj:0: Bring 8 Trophy Swoop Quills to Harken Windtotem in Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:761:details:0: The swoop is a cunning bird, and difficult to find and hunt. A collection of Swoop Quills is a badge of cleverness and determination for a hunter.
rows.quest:761:details:1: BIf you are willing to take up this task, then enter the plains and hunt the swoop.
rows.quest:761:details:2: BBring me their quills, and bring honor to your clan.
rows.quest:761:details:3: BThe swoops may be found anywhere in ⟦E1⟧, but your eyes must be sharp to spot them, and your hooves must be quick to catch them.
rows.quest:761:completion:0: I know that gathering these quills was not an easy task, ⟦15⟧. In doing this, you prove that you are a ⟦16⟧ of merit. It is good to have you at Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:764:obj:0: Kill 14 Venture Co. Workers and 6 Venture Co. Supervisors for Morin Cloudstalker at Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:764:details:0: This explains the buildup of Venture Co. employees and equipment we've seen in ⟦E1⟧. Those goblins... their company is expanding too quickly for their own good. It's how they say, show a goblin something, and you can hear the scales in the background.
rows.quest:764:details:1: BGreedy little things, they are. Unfortunately for their business enterprise, we tauren cannot allow them to conduct their operations in our lands. Go to their mine northeast of the ravaged caravan and send them a message.
rows.quest:764:completion:0: I don't think there could be too much misinterpreting or ignoring of that signal, hm? The Venture Co. will know not to take the tauren lightly, or to be so arrogant as to believe we would allow them to steal the natural resources around us without protest.
rows.quest:765:obj:0: Kill Supervisor Fizsprocket and return his clipboard to Morin Cloudstalker at Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:765:details:0: According to the documents you salvaged from the caravan, the Venture Co. created many plans to attempt to drive us from our lands here, so that they could have free reign to plunder our lands.
rows.quest:765:details:1: BThe depths that they would sink to accomplish their goals disgusts and appalls me. I want the mastermind behind their plans killed. His name is Supervisor Fizsprocket, you will find him at the Venture Co. mine east of the ravaged caravan. Bring me his clipboard, we shall see if we find out anything useful.
rows.quest:765:completion:0: My anger is somewhat lessened at the news that the villain Fizsprocket is dead. I will go through his personal effects and see if there is any additional information about what the Venture Co. has planned for the future. Thank you for your efforts, ⟦17⟧.
rows.quest:766:obj:0: Bring a Prairie Wolf Heart, Flatland Cougar Femur, Plainstrider Scale and Swoop Gizzard to Maur Raincaller at Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:766:details:0: My grandfather told me stories about his battles with a strider named Mazzranache. He told me of its demonic red eyes, razor-sharp talons and venomous bite.
rows.quest:766:details:1: BAs fortune would have it, while traveling across the plains, I encountered it, and it took a nasty bite from my shoulder. He was as terrible as my grandfather described. I will need some hard-to-find animal parts to clean the infection from his bite: a wolf heart, cougar femur, plainstrider scale and swoop gizzard.
rows.quest:766:details:2: BHurry, time is of the essence.
rows.quest:766:completion:0: Ah, thank you, ⟦18⟧. Using the items you brought me, I will be able to create the remedy I need to stop the spread of the infection and, eventually, cure it completely. I owe you my life in thanks.
rows.quest:766:completion:1: BBut I'll never forget that screeching call when Mazzranache came upon me, the blaze of color as its beak descended...
rows.quest:767:obj:0: Speak with Zarlman Two-Moons in Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:767:details:0: The Rite of Vision, one of the Rites of the Earthmother, will help guide you toward earning the respect of the elders of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:767:details:1: BOur people have learned that the land is our most holy provider. In order to take part in the ritualistic vision, you must speak with the spiritual leader of the village, Zarlman Two-Moons.
rows.quest:767:completion:0: I sensed you would be coming to me, ⟦19⟧. I can always recognize one who is trying to pass the Rites of the Earthmother.
rows.quest:770:obj:0: Find someone who knows of Ghost Howl.
rows.quest:770:details:0: The ragged hide of Ghost Howl still bears a terrible wound, gained from the wolf's battles against the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:770:details:1: BPerhaps someone in Bloodhoof Village should know of Ghost Howl's demise....
rows.quest:770:completion:0: I can barely believe my old eyes! You defeated the great wolf Ghost Howl? I look upon you with new respect, young ⟦20⟧. You are a ⟦21⟧ of extreme skills!
rows.quest:770:completion:1: BLet me offer you something. My days of hunting are over, but I would be honored if you used one of my weapons in your hunts.
rows.quest:770:completion:2: BMay it strike true, and bring you renown.
rows.quest:770:completion:3: BAnd let us hope that Ghost Howl's spirit has finally found peace.
rows.quest:771:obj:0: Collect 2 Well Stones and 2 Ambercorn and bring them back to Zarlman Two-Moons in Bloodhoof Village.
rows.quest:771:details:0: In order to pass through the Rite of Vision, you must gather the reagents needed to make the Water of the Seers.
rows.quest:771:details:1: BI will need well stones, which can be found around the water wells in ⟦E1⟧. With those I will combine Ambercorn, which fall beneath the mighty trees in our land.
rows.quest:771:details:2: BThese reagents contain magical elements, and when brewed and consumed before the tribal fire, will cause you to encounter a vision. Follow it, and it will lead you to the next step of this holy quest.
rows.quest:771:completion:0: I see you have learned to gather from our sacred land, ⟦22⟧. It will take but a moment for me to brew the Water of the Seers.
rows.quest:772:obj:0: Consume the Water of the Seers in front of the tribal fire in Bloodhoof Village and follow the vision once it appears.
rows.quest:772:details:0: I now present you with the Water of the Seers.
rows.quest:772:details:1: BWhen you are ready, consume the waters near the tribal fire. Once you have ingested the holy waters, it will take a few moments before the vision materializes before the fire.
rows.quest:772:details:2: BAt that point, it is up to you to follow it to your destiny....
rows.quest:772:completion:0: Be not afraid, ⟦23⟧. You have successfully passed the Rite of Vision.
rows.quest:773:obj:0: ⟦E7⟧ to Red Rocks east of ⟦E2⟧ and speak with the Ancestral Spirit.
rows.quest:773:details:0: To gain acceptance amongst the elders of ⟦E2⟧ you must next complete the Rite of Wisdom.
rows.quest:773:details:1: BNow that you have passed the Rite of Vision, the ancestral spirits of Red Rocks will give you the blessing of our ancestors. Only those who have drunk from the Water of Seers can gain the blessing.
rows.quest:773:details:2: BTravel east of ⟦E2⟧, to Red Rocks and seek out the Ancestral Spirit, ⟦24⟧.
rows.quest:773:completion:0: You have shown great diligence in your yearning to pass the Rites of the Earthmother, ⟦25⟧.
rows.quest:773:completion:1: BWe, the Ancestral Spirits, represent the mighty tauren who gave their lives bravely to found and protect our great city of ⟦E2⟧. I hereby pass the duty of that protection over to you.
rows.quest:773:completion:2: BYou have passed the Rite of Wisdom, young ⟦26⟧. Enter ⟦E2⟧ with pride.
rows.quest:775:details:0: You will now be revered within our great city. Any ⟦27⟧ worthy of completing the Rites of the Earthmother earns that honor.
rows.quest:775:details:1: BFor your final quest, seek out our noble leader, Cairne Bloodhoof, who dwells atop the highest mesa in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:775:completion:0: Hail, young ⟦28⟧. I see you found your way to my doorstep.
rows.quest:776:obj:0: Cairne Bloodhoof in ⟦E2⟧ wants you to bring him the Horn of Arra'chea.
rows.quest:776:details:0: You have passed the Rites of the Earthmother and earned your place in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:776:details:1: BBut in order to maintain the spot that you strived so hard to achieve, you must continue to prove your worth to your people.
rows.quest:776:details:2: BWe are hunters, ⟦29⟧. Down below in ⟦E1⟧ there is a mighty kodo named Arra'chea. Show me your skills in the ways of tracking and hunting by bringing me the Horn of Arra'chea.
rows.quest:776:completion:0: Well done! A fine kill that was.
rows.quest:776:completion:1: BI will send a gathering party to collect the carcass so we can retrieve the hide and meat.
rows.quest:776:completion:2: BYou have done a great deed for your people, ⟦30⟧.
rows.quest:833:obj:0: Lorekeeper Raintotem wants you to kill 8 Bristleback Interlopers at Red Rocks.
rows.quest:833:details:0: Only the most valiant tauren are laid to rest at Red Rocks, our sacred burial ground. It is an honor bestowed upon the great warriors who helped found and defend ⟦E2⟧ and those who have given their lives for the greater good of their tribes and chieftains.
rows.quest:833:details:1: BBut it appears a foul menace has made its way onto our holy land. A band of Bristleback Interlopers is ravaging the grave site and I am too old and past my prime to drive them away.
rows.quest:833:details:2: BThey must be driven off with force, ⟦31⟧.
rows.quest:833:completion:0: Well done. You have sent those foul Bristlebacks a clear message. They will think twice before attempting to meddle in this holy spot again.
rows.quest:854:obj:0: Speak with Thork at the Crossroads in the ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:854:details:0: I have foreseen your arrival, young ⟦32⟧. Though perhaps you are not so young anymore.
rows.quest:854:details:1: BI think that it is time for you to move deeper into this land. I can sense that you are destined for great things.
rows.quest:854:details:2: BIt is the Crossroads that you must seek out, for our lives with the orcs have become intertwined and they need assistance. Continue down this road towards the east and follow it north to the Crossroads. Find Thork within its walls, he has the Earthmother's blessing.
rows.quest:854:completion:0: It is good to see that more of our ⟦33⟧ allies have come to assist us from as far away as ⟦E2⟧. Again, I welcome you.
rows.quest:861:obj:0: Bring 4 Flatland Prowler Claws to Melor Stonehoof in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:861:details:0: You are eager to explore, I can tell. I too had the lust to wander, once...
rows.quest:861:details:1: BWander, and hunt. For hunting is a Tauren's greatest honor.
rows.quest:861:details:2: BIf you truly wish to follow the ways of the hunter, then Melor Stonehoof can show you the path. He is in ⟦E2⟧, on the Hunter's Rise.
rows.quest:861:details:3: BAnd to show him your skill and resolve, bring him the claws of the flatland prowlers of ⟦E1⟧. They are tough and cunning -- fitting prey for a young ⟦34⟧ on the hunter's path.
rows.quest:861:completion:0: Skorn Whitecloud is a wise tauren. He has hunted for years and years, and although his body is old, his spirit burns fiercely. We are honored to have him with us.
rows.quest:861:completion:1: BIf Skorn sent you to me, then you too must have the hunter's spirit. And to have gathered these claws shows your burgeoning skills.
rows.quest:861:completion:2: BPerhaps you are ready to walk the path.
